summary.headline: Astrological Questions, Folios 100v–108v
summary.text: Catalog of astrological questions from folios 100v–108v, covering ruler duration, lots, planetary predominance and aspects, fortunate and afflicted nativities, political rulers, wars, slavery, eclipses, and related horary and inception topics. Authorities and subjects include Stephanos, the Arabs, Jupiter, Saturn, Mars, the Sun, Moon, and Mercury.
